summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward long-term bullishness on the broad market, evidenced by massive $164.9M accumulations in SPX 7000C (2026) and significant call premiums in NVDA (P/C 0.29) and AMD (P/C 0.48). A highly persistent, multi-day accumulation pattern is visible in SPX 7000C strikes across various 2026 expirations, totaling billions in premium over the last four sessions. While there is heavy long-term call buying, the high Put/Call ratio in SPY (1.96) and META (1.44) suggests immediate-term hedging or bearish sentiment in those specific names. Traders should monitor for continued strength in SPX as the massive 2026 call interest provides a structural floor, but watch for volatility spikes in SMH following the $129.6M 630P accumulation.
